quest.title: Let the Wind Lead
quest.description: The mysterious fellow claimed to be a bard named Venti, but left on his own accord before you could get him to explain his relationship with the dragon. You follow him to the giant tree at Windrise.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x20, Mora x5450, Character EXP x2850, Fine Enhancement Ore x5

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Familiar? I don't know... You're alone on that one...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Oh? What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Though I was just wondering if you would happen to follow me...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I want to know more about the Anemo God.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: You speak of the God of Anemo, Barbatos? He already disappeared from Mondstadt a long time ago.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Liyue and Inazuma's respective gods of Geo and Electro are still present, but Mondstadt has seen many a moon since they last saw their own god.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Why do you wish to know about the God of Anemo? Does it have something to do with Dvalin?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, someone told me about Dvalin's past.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Just how is it that everyone sees Stormterror? I'm quite curious.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: That said, there's no need to rush...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I have not been back in a while, it seems there are a few who are unhappy with my arrival.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The wind... I can't... open my eyes...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Seems the dragon wasn't the only thing affected by this change in the wind...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Now then, you were saying someone had told you about the dragon?
